# Mac Manager 0.8.0

These are draft notes for the planned first public preview of the Stage 1 feature set for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.

## Highlights

- Live CPU, GPU, RAM and AppleSMC power readings.
- Five-minute in-memory history with gaps for sleep and unavailable samples.
- Primary local and public IPv4 information.
- Independent mouse scroll reversal with automatic mouse and trackpad classification.
- Native menu bar panel with optional CPU, GPU, RAM and power values.
- Background operation, configurable Dock presence and launch at login.
- Weekly GitHub release checks, local diagnostics and Polish and English interfaces.

## Planned installation

The public artifact has not been published yet. When version 0.8.0 is available:

1. Download `MacManager-v0.8.0-arm64.dmg` from its GitHub release.
2. Open the disk image and drag Mac Manager to Applications.
3. Open Mac Manager from Applications.
4. Grant Accessibility and Input Monitoring only if you enable mouse scroll reversal.

The published application will be signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. It will not require disabling Gatekeeper.

## Known limitations

- This release supports Apple Silicon only.
- Hardware validation was performed on the reference MacBook Pro; broader model coverage remains ongoing.
- AppleSMC power availability and values can differ between Mac models.
- The app reports tunnel interfaces conservatively and does not attribute public IP addresses to individual applications.
- Temperature and fan monitoring are planned for Stage 2.
- Clipboard history, notch-area UI and music controls are planned for Stage 3.

Mac Manager is free and open source under GNU AGPL v3.0 only. Scroll Reverser adaptations retain their Apache-2.0 attribution.
